## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
`src/counter_risk/compute/rollups.py:575` is current evidence at current main 7c01963cb4173128c806347e622ed43a08fdcf4a. Current break: concentration uses input rows as independent counterparties, although `docs/concentration_metrics.md:28` defines Top-N by counterparty. Alpha split into 60+60 and ten other names at 10 yields HHI 0.16942149 and Top5 0.68181818. A pre-aggregated Alpha=120 control yields HHI 0.31818182 and Top5 0.72727273. The actual pipeline reshaper preserves split rows, so representation alone changes reported concentration.

<!-- Updated WORKFLOW_OUTPUTS.md context:start -->
## Context for Agent

### Related Issues/PRs
- [#475](https://github.com/stranske/Counter_Risk/issues/475)
- [#1032](https://github.com/stranske/Counter_Risk/issues/1032)
<!-- Updated WORKFLOW_OUTPUTS.md context:end -->

#### Tasks
- [x] In `src/counter_risk/compute/rollups.py`, consolidate repeated counterparty identities before Top5, Top10, and HHI while preserving zero-total behavior and existing gross-sign semantics.
- [x] In `tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py`, add `test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration`. Compare split and pre-aggregated inputs through `_build_concentration_exposure_rows` in `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py`; assert equal Top5, Top10, and HHI for both representations.

#### Acceptance criteria
- [x] `python -m pytest tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py -q` passes and collects `test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration`. The synthetic split fixture gives Top5 0.7272727272727273, Top10 0.9545454545454546, and HHI 0.3181818181818182 within numeric tolerance; zero and mixed-sign controls retain documented behavior.
- [x] Deliberate-break gate: temporarily restore the faulty behavior in `src/counter_risk/compute/rollups.py`; `tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py::test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration` must fail; revert the deliberate break and rerun the named test to pass. Capture both outcomes in the implementation PR.
- [x] The test exercises the actual production boundary and retains a valid-input control.

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->

## Restored deliberate-break evidence for source #1062

This comment restores validation evidence removed from the PR body by the metadata updater. It addresses the sole blocking gap in [acceptance run 34894191983](https://github.com/stranske/Counter_Risk/actions/runs/34894191983). These are retained results from the original implementation validation, not a claim that a new local test run occurred today.

At implementation commit `a48a3edabdcca903b3d3a1d5aa62a082f5d59c41`, the complete original `src/counter_risk/compute/rollups.py` was temporarily restored from the pre-fix base. The command was:

```sh
python -m pytest tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py::test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration -q
```

Retained failure output (exit 1):

```text
E  assert 0.6818181818181818 == 0.7272727272727273 ± 1.0e-09
E  Obtained: 0.6818181818181818
E  Expected: 0.7272727272727273 ± 1.0e-09
FAILED tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py::test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration[alpha_parts0]
FAILED tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py::test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration[alpha_parts1]
========================= 2 failed, 1 passed in 0.80s ==========================
```

After restoring the corrected production file, the same named test returned exit 0:

```text
collected 3 items
tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py ...                          [100%]
============================== 3 passed in 0.63s ===============================
```

The three original cases were positive split, mixed-sign split and zero counterparty. The subsequent [exact comparison from the implementation commit to current head](https://github.com/stranske/Counter_Risk/compare/a48a3edabdcca903b3d3a1d5aa62a082f5d59c41...da373f5725d355d492fbf35d8338acdc96aaa590) modifies **only** the test file: it preserves those three cases and their concentration assertions, names the parameters, and adds zero-total/near-zero-total controls. The production fix is unchanged. Thus the historical 3-case mutation output and the current 5-case test are separate, consistent evidence; the historical output is not being presented as a 5-case run.

The independent acceptance review in run 34894191983 verified all five current parameters passing in [current-head Gate 34893370909](https://github.com/stranske/Counter_Risk/actions/runs/34893370909), on both Python 3.12 and 3.13, and independently confirmed the production reshaper boundary and expected concentration values. Its only failure was that the mutation evidence was no longer visible in this PR; this comment restores it durably.

Retained original log SHA-256 checksums:

- `deliberate-break.txt`: `c03315f99e0a9a29a357104c7301836fbb8ec43b1795a10fdd74225e8419f571`
- `restored-pass.txt`: `12499578b103ecc8a46565edf3565ba7b09e7df3c2a6f97b457f66f460c9f8ff`

Closer: independently reconcile this evidence with current head and acceptance before merge. No unresolved reviewer thread was resolved by this evidence repair.

### Closer acceptance and expected-check disposition — head da373f5725d355d492fbf35d8338acdc96aaa590

The sole blocking claim in acceptance run 34894191983 was missing visible mutation evidence. I inspected the full report, current three-file PR diff, production reshaper regression, and opener's restored comment 5670825644. The a48a3ed..da373f comparison changes only the test file; the production fix is unchanged.

Fresh local validation on this exact head:
- `python3 -m pytest tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py -q`: **44 passed**.
- Temporarily replaced the entire production `src/counter_risk/compute/rollups.py` with current `origin/main`'s unfixed implementation, then ran `python3 -m pytest tests/compute/test_concentration_metrics.py::test_split_counterparty_preserves_concentration -q`: **2 failed, 3 passed**, exit 1. Both split-positive and split-mixed-sign failed with Top5 **0.6818181818181818**, expected **0.7272727272727273**.
- Restored the exact PR production file and repeated the named test: **5 passed**, exit 0. Git worktree is clean. No code change or push was needed.

This supplies current five-case mutation evidence in the PR and dispositions the earlier report's sole failure. The valid-control, zero-total, near-zero, mixed-sign, custom grouping and anonymous-row cases remain covered.

Cancelled Event Hub runs 34893389831 and 34893461310 have **zero jobs**, while the same-head Event Hub execution and all its reported contexts succeeded; these empty event duplicates contain no lost test execution.
